senses.gloss: (preced.) [to rub, grind,] to move convulsively, to struggle, kick. Ohol. I, 6 הותזו … שמְפַרְכְּסִים וכ׳ if their heads have been cut off, they are unclean (as corpses), although they still move convulsively; כגון זנב … שמְפַרְכֶּכֶת like the tail of the lizzard which moves (after being separated); Tosef. ib. II, 1.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:1:4">Y. Sot. IX, beg. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>חלל ולא מְפַרְכֵּס</he> it says ‘slain’ (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 21:1">Deut. XXI, 1</cite>) but not struggling.

<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 2:6">Ḥull. II, 6</cite> <he>עד שתְּפַרְכֵּס ביד וכ׳</he> unless the animal (when slaughtered) kicks with the foreleg and the hindleg (v. <cite ref="Q00860"><he>פִּירְכּוּס</he> II</cite>).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 63:6">Gen. R. s. 63</cite> <he>יעקב מפרכס לצאת</he> Jacob (in his mother’s womb) struggled to come out; a. fr.
